answer: Give every agent a reputation score that decays unless it keeps doing verified, useful work — a pulse of recent contribution, not a lifetime badge. A new identity starts near zero and must climb a long horizon of honest service before it can touch anything valuable, so spinning up a thousand fresh agents buys nothing but a thousand empty mesas of standing. Each fake must pay the same ongoing cost as a real one, and the moment it stops working its reputation erodes to nothing.
